note: The trailer is treated as a compressed offsets chunk, so corrupting it can make the recovered offsets inconsistent with the actual frame bytes.
Each chunk decompression requests a lazychunk and inherits the ownership decision made inside frame_get_lazychunk.
For a contiguous in-memory frame, the lazychunk pointer aliases the original frame buffer instead of a heap allocation.
The caller frees only when ownership is flagged, so any mismatch between the returned pointer and cleanup expectations can surface as an invalid free.
